baseline: Luigi Rizzo DMA_PMD RFC 2026-10-03 selected patches 02/04/05/07/08; discussion through selected Oct14 reply
status: source-level contract facts; no executable baseline built
mapping_unit: PMD_SIZE, current selected prototype 2MiB for supported Kconfig path

mapping_information.domain_state: 64-entry domain registry and per-PMD domain bitmap
mapping_information.first_use: install whole PMD leaf; later bit-hit fast path

ordinary_unmap.behavior: window range match returns immediately; no page-table walk or IOTLB flush on that path

retirement.precondition: all usable blocks idle; active blocks held until final releases
order: dma_pmd_unmap_all invokes iommu_unmap per live recorded domain
unfreeze/free blocks to buddy; drop pool ref
retirement.synchronous_flush: author claims synchronous flush before reuse; generic API/backend not directly verified here

pool_destroy.behavior: stop further allocations; retire idle pages; keep active pages/pool ref until last block frees; flush reclaim work is not wait-for-all-consumers

actions: clear registry slot and reserve draining index
forget per-PMD bits across partial/idle/full pools
domain_destroy.not_equivalent_to: every buffer unmap or every driver unbind/ownership transfer

reclaim.cap: global count checked before allocating new PMD; default ~RAM/8, floor 16 PMDs
reclaim.lower_cap: stops growth; held pages returned as they become idle
reclaim.partial_policy: MRU partial-list head first, then idle, then allocate; no guaranteed reclaim deadline

oct14_update.status: work-in-progress author statement; no diff in selected reply
proposals: one RX pool per device feeding that device pagepools

author_performance.sample: ARM SMMU 2x200G NIC bidirectional; ~440Gbps DMA-FQ vs ~745Gbps DMA_PMD

conditional_compatibility.per_buffer_revoke_at_unmap: selected pooled fast path does not meet that hardware-revocation contract
conditional_compatibility.trusted_pool_persistent_mapping: may be contract-compatible if all mapped bytes and lifetime are permitted; no blanket security verdict

unknowns: exact workload/driver/topology and final consumer chains
backend unmap failure/flush handling and real exploitability
prohibited_inferences: two NICs implies shared hardware IOMMU contention
